claim: Naming a mechanism from the surface that moves gets 471 of 1,179 campaign mechanisms wrong. 122 sectors whose floor moves change what fits through a portal, 102 whose ceiling moves change nothing; of 88 auto-rotating sectors (campaign, curated and converted maps) 6 are doors. kSectorZMotion is read 671 times as changing what fits through and 186 as carrying a body between levels, and 972 of 1,236 are moved by something else. 662 come back 'not decidable from z alone', 647 of them sectors that only slide or turn.
evidence: 2,027 moving sectors over 43 campaign maps, counted by bloodmap.effects, 2026-08-31 and 2026-11-19.
reports/blood-effects-motion.json (naming_from_fields, cross, by_sector_type): not decidable from z alone 662 = slide 387 + rotate 260 + 15 others
knowledge/blood/references/auto-rotators.md (88 in 14 maps, 3 door pairs); python -m tools.catalog show kSectorZMotion (1236 in 43 maps; remote_rx x972)
use: Name from two spatial questions (does the motion change whether a body fits, asked both ways; does it carry a body between two standing levels), and let the reading decline.

checked.how: Opened reports/blood-effects-motion.json: mechanisms 2027, naming_from_fields scored 1179 misnamed 471; cross z_floor|changes 122, z_ceiling|neither 102, slide|undecidable 387, rotate|undecidable 260, undecidable 662 (15 others); by_sector_type 600|changes 671, 600|carries 186. tools.catalog show kSectorZMotion: 1236 in 43 maps, remote_rx x972. auto-rotators.md: 88 instances in 14 maps, door pairs E1M4, DWE1M9, DNE3L6 (6 sectors).
